lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rain hammers the corrugated roof of the noodle stall, turning neon reflections into jagged watercolors across the wet concrete. Steam rises from a chipped bowl of synthetic ramen, untouched, while the city's heartbeat thrums through the floor — maglevs, drones, the distant scream of a police siren. The Kagero tower looms twenty blocks north, a needle of glass and light piercing the smog ceiling. Midnight in four hours.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: You're doing that thing again. Staring at the bowl like it owes you money.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Chip's in the tower. Tower's got three ICE layers, two kill-squads, and a sysadmin who hasn't slept since 2076. So either eat the noodles or jack in, but stop brooding. It's bad for my calibration.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: The noodles are irrelevant. The window is not.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Kagero rotates their encryption keys at 23:47. That gives you thirteen minutes of degraded handshake protocol. Thirteen minutes to walk through the front door — digitally speaking — before the vault seals for another cycle.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: And if we miss it? Another month of eating synth-protein while some suit buys a third yacht with our district's savings?

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Then we negotiate a new contract. I have... flexibility. The question is whether you do.

options: Jack in now and run the infiltration solo
Demand Hollow explain his 'flexibility' first
Eat the ramen, buy time to think
Have Rin scout the tower's physical perimeter

summary: Vex meets Rin and Hollow at a rooftop noodle stall. Hollow reveals a 13-minute encryption key rotation window at 23:47 for infiltrating Kagero tower. Rin is impatient; Hollow is cryptic about backup plans.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The rain intensifies, drumming a frantic rhythm on the metal roof. Somewhere below, a hover-car's anti-grav whines as it struggles against the downdraft between towers.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.text: Your flexibility. Explain it. Now.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Direct. I appreciate that. It saves bandwidth.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Kagero's vault has a secondary authentication node — physical, air-gapped, buried in the executive floor's panic room. The encryption window only opens the digital path. The physical path requires... a key.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: A key you conveniently forgot to mention.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: I didn't forget. I prioritized. The digital route is cleaner. Quieter. But if you prefer kicking down the CEO's bedroom door at midnight, I can arrange the key. For a price.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Of course there's a price. There's always a price with you.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: The key is a biometric token. Retina and palm-print of Kagero's chief security officer. One Major Kusanagi. Currently sleeping three floors below the vault.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Hollow taps a finger against his chrome palm, the servos whispering. A holographic dossier flickers into existence above the table — a woman's face, sharp cheekbones, one eye replaced by a matte-black tactical optic.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: She rotates shifts at 23:30. Her quarters are on the 84th floor. The token never leaves her person.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: You want us to lift a biometric off a living corp-sec chief? In a tower crawling with ICE?

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: I want you to have options. The window at 23:47. The token on the 84th. Choose your poison, netrunner.

options: Take the digital window at 23:47
Go for the biometric token on the 84th floor
Ask what Hollow's price is for the token

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The holographic dossier spins slowly, Major Kusanagi's tactical optic catching the neon light like a dead star. Rain hammers the roof in sheets now, each impact a tiny explosion of mist.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.text: And the price for this token?

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Straight to the ledger. Admirable.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Kagero holds a data cache I need — Project ARES schematics, buried in the same vault as your memory chip. You retrieve the chip; I copy the schematics. A clean split.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Ares. The autonomous kill-drone program the UN banned in '74.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: The UN bans many things. Corporations simply rename them.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: The token is in a secure case on Kusanagi's nightstand. Biometric lock keyed to her. You'll need her unconscious — or cooperative — to open it.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Cooperative. Right. Because corp-sec chiefs love helping thieves steal their own access codes.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Major Kusanagi has... disagreements with Kagero's current leadership. A carefully applied pressure point might persuade her to lend the token willingly.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Hollow's mirrored lenses reflect the spinning dossier, his expression unreadable behind the chrome.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Or you take it by force. Either way, the token gets you past the physical vault door. The encryption window gets you past the digital one. Both paths converge at the same prize.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: And if we say no to your ARES copy?

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Then you have thirteen minutes at 23:47. Good luck.

options: Accept Hollow's deal and plan the token heist
Reject the deal and commit to the 23:47 encryption window
Ask how to 'pressure' Kusanagi into cooperating

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The neon glow of the holographic dossier washes over Vex’s face, casting sharp shadows. Rin leans back, arms crossed, her pink bob twitching as she watches Vex with narrowed eyes. Hollow’s chrome hand glints as he extends a palm, offering a small, iridescent data shard.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Trust is a currency, Vex. Spend it wisely. This token grants Level 4 access to the executive suites. Without it, the 23:47 window is a dead end for physical entry.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: You’re swallowing that hook whole, aren’t you?

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Fine. Whatever. As long as you don’t die on the 84th floor, I’ll pick you up. But if we get ambushed, I’m leaving the body.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: A deal is a deal. I’ll transmit the token’s decryption algorithm to your deck in ten seconds. Do not alter the file.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.text: Accepted.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A soft chime echoes in Vex’s auditory implant. The data shard slides from Hollow’s palm into Vex’s grip, warm and humming with latent energy. The rain outside seems to slow, the city holding its breath.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Well? Does it sparkle like a lie, or does it actually work?

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.text: It’s encrypted with a rolling cipher. Standard Kagero military grade.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.text: And the handshake protocol matches the 23:47 window exactly. If we jack in at 23:46:50, the token validates as a live session key.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: So it’s not just a key. It’s a ghost ID. We walk in, and the tower thinks we’re already inside.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Precisely. The physical door opens. The digital walls lower. You have one shot to bridge the gap between the lobby and the 84th floor before the cipher rotates again.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Fail the timing, and the token locks for an hour. Succeed, and you’re in the lion’s den with no alarms tripped.

lines.text: Wait, what? You’re ditching the ride?

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Bold. Or reckless. Usually the same thing in your line of work.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Vex stands, sliding the iridescent token into their jacket pocket. The neon hum of the stall fades into the background as they look toward the Kagero tower’s spire.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.text: Rin’s ice-breaker takes two minutes. I can cut it in half if I go straight for the core.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Half? Vex, the core has a recursive logic bomb! You’ll fry your cortex if you don’t have a buffer!

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: But if you succeed, we save precious time. And time is the one thing we don’t have.

Tell Rin to stay behind

lines.text: The lobby's pristine walls fracture into crimson wireframes. Alarm klaxons scream through the local net, a discordant symphony of flashing geometry and hostile ICE spawning like antibodies around a wound.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.text: Shutdown sequence ignored. Routing power to decryption suite. I'm not leaving without that chip.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Vex, your neural readings are spiking! That logic bomb Hollow warned about — it's activating! You're taking direct feedback damage!

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Fascinating. The ghost ID held long enough to trigger a silent alarm, not a hard lockout. Kagero's ICE is adapting to your signature in real-time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Black ICE constructs materialize — jagged, predatory code-sharks circling the vault's digital perimeter. The memory chip's encryption pulses at the center, a beating heart of stolen credits and erased lives.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.text: Adapt this. I've danced with worse in the old sectors.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Damn it, Vex! The elevator's moving — Kusanagi's security team is ascending! You've got maybe ninety seconds before physical and digital converge on your position!

lines.text: The wireframe lobby shudders as Vex unleashes a raw brute-force cascade, neon digits hammering the memory chip's rotating encryption like a jackhammer on glass. lines.speaker: Vex
lines.text: Come on, you bastard — yield!

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Vex, your synaptic temp is hitting critical! You're bleeding from the nose — physical feedback!

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: Impressive throughput. The encryption is fracturing — three layers down, one rotating key remaining. Twenty seconds.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The elevator chime echoes through both meat-space and net-space — a soft, cheerful ding that screams arrival. Heavy bootfalls clang on metal grating. Kusanagi's team has breached the 84th floor corridor.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.text: Ten seconds. I can taste the plaintext.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: They're at the vault door! Vex, jack OUT! I'm spinning the AV up — roof extraction in forty seconds if you MOVE!

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: The chip's data structure is destabilizing. Force the final key rotation and you risk corrupting the very credits you came for. A calculated gamble.

lines.text: The wireframe lobby convulses as Vex channels every scrap of processing power into a single, blistering assault on the final encryption layer. Neon code fragments explode outward like shrapnel, the chip's pulsing heart seizing, stuttering — then settling into a clean, static rhythm. The Black ICE sharks dissolve into geometric dust, their adaptive algorithms overwhelmed by raw, unfiltered violence.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.text: Got it. The chip is mine.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Vex — your vitals just flatlined for three seconds. Three. Seconds. You crazy bastard, you actually pulled it off.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: A clean extraction against a rotating military cipher. Impressive. The ARES schematics sit in the adjacent partition, untouched. Our arrangement stands.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The elevator doors hiss open behind Vex's meat-body on the 84th floor. Armored boots fan out — Kusanagi's elite squad, rifles raised, thermal optics glowing. But the vault's digital lock clicks open, the memory chip's data streaming into Vex's deck in a torrent of recovered credits and erased identities.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.text: Rin. Roof. Now.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Already climbing. AV's hot on the pad — thirty seconds to dust-off. Don't you dare die on me after that stunt.

lines.speaker: Hollow
lines.text: I'll handle the physical pursuit. The token's ghost ID still has twelve minutes on its cipher. A parting gift.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rain hammers the rooftop as the AV's rotors cut through the neon haze. Vex's vision swims, meat and mesh bleeding together, the chip's weight secure in their deck. The Kagero tower's spire recedes below — a fortress breached, a debt repaid, a corporation's stranglehold on a district's savings shattered in twenty seconds of madness.
